# Contributing

## Filing an issue

Use the issue forms at [New issue](https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy/issues/new/choose).
They add the right labels and issue Type automatically.

If you file issues with a script, the GitHub API or a coding agent, it skips the
form. Use the form's exact headings (`### Heading`, then the answer) so triage
still works. Pick each dropdown answer from the form's options exactly.

Bug report (title starts `[BUG] `):

- `### What went wrong?`
- `### How can we reproduce it?`
- `### Where did this happen?` (Web browser, iOS app, Android app, Integration or background activity, Server or installation, Multiple platforms, Other / Not Sure)
- `### Floppy version`
- `### Database` (optional)
- `### Screenshots & additional context` (optional)
- `### Logs & diagnostics`

Feature request (title starts `[Feature Request] `):

- `### What does your request primarily relate to?` (Interface & Usability, Tracking & Media Management, Integrations & Data Sources, Performance & Technical, Other / Not Sure)
- `### What would you like Floppy to do?`
- `### Additional context` (optional)

Floppy adds the `bug` or `enhancement` label, the Type and a category label from
these headings when the issue opens. Check logs for private data before sharing
them, and report security problems privately (see `SECURITY.md`).
